data.gender_notes: Nithya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nithya refers to the eternal, continuous, and unchanging nature of the universe and the divine. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'nith' meaning 'eternal'. The name Nithya carries the meaning “Eternal, Continuous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nithya usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal, continuous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of the eternal and unchanging nature of the universe and the divine.
data.etymology: Nithya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eternal, Continuous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nithya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nithya holds immense cultural significance in the Hindu tradition, particularly within the realm of spirituality and philosophy. It symbolizes the unchanging nature of the universe, which is deeply rooted in the Hindu belief of the cyclical nature of time. This name is also considered auspicious and is believed to bring good fortune, stability, and continuity in one's life.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Nithya signifies the eternal nature of the divine and the soul. It reminds us of our ultimate connection to the eternal and unchanging reality beyond the transient world we perceive with our senses. Furthermore, Nithya also signifies the eternal wisdom and knowledge that is inherent within us, waiting to be discovered and realized. It is a reminder to stay connected to the divine and to remain focused on the eternal aspect of our being, beyond the changing circumstances of our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nithya, meaning 'eternal' or 'perpetual' in Sanskrit, embodies the essence of continuous existence and unending devotion. It symbolizes the everlasting nature of the soul and the divine spirit within us.

vedic_reference.note: Nithya is a name of Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity in Hinduism.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Nithya was a goddess in the Hindu pantheon, associated with the cycles of time and the cosmos. The name Nithya carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Nithya was a goddess in the Hindu pantheon, associated with the cycles of time and the cosmos. She was often depicted as a goddess of the night, and her name means 'eternal' or 'permanent'.
